usages.explain: Used to express the speaker's speculation or intention in a situation where the result is already determined. The following part often expresses the speaker's resigned or yielding attitude.

examples.content: どうせ遅れるのだから、いまさら慌てても仕方がない。
examples.transcription: どうせおくれるのだから、いまさらあわててもしかたがない。
examples.mean: It's going to be late anyway, so there's no point in panicking now.

examples.content: どうせ不合格なのだから、気にしないで。
examples.transcription: どうせふごうかくなのだから、きにしないで。
examples.mean: Don't worry about it, you'll fail anyway.

title: どうせ…のだから => anyhow; in any case; at any rate; after all; no matter what
